texts: Our company is the seller on a standing order: Velquince Instruments Ltd buys replacement seals from us every quarter. The loading-bay door is blue.

When Ardrill Packaging Cooperative supplies cartons to our company, we are its buyer; it has never bought from us. Conversely, Yewlark Survey Works pays our company for calibration services this year. The workshop clock shows 08:40.
Pelthren Glassworks was our company's customer from 2017 through 2019. Its purchasing agreement ended in 2019, and it is no longer our customer. The archive uses green folders.
The closed account belongs to Orrivane Orchard Services Ltd, a former buyer of our company's irrigation timers; no sales relationship remains today. A spare key hangs beside the door.
Please correct the ledger: Brindlequay Cartography Ltd has never been a customer of our company. The incorrect entry records no purchase. The display shelf has four levels.
A visitor mistook the exhibitor for our client, but Kestrelune Ceramic Cooperative is not and has never been our company's customer. The demonstration starts at 14:20.
The envelope on the desk bears the name Nimbrel Arc Labs Ltd. Nothing in the accompanying note describes a business relationship with our company. The desk lamp has a white shade.

Our company's archivist found a photograph captioned 'Wexor Lantern Association'. The file does not establish whether that organization ever bought anything from us. The photograph is stored in drawer three.

Our company's handbook calls the party paying for a service the customer and the party providing it the supplier. These are role descriptions, with no organization named. The handbook has a yellow cover.

At our company, a cooperative, a limited company, or a public agency may apply for an account. The application template gives only organization types and identifies no actual applicant. The training room opens at 09:15.

In the first sentence of the exercise, quiver means a case for arrows. In the second, quiver is the entire registered name of the organization that now buys cases from our company. The exercise is printed on one sheet.

The editor wrote hush to mean silence in the margin. The invoice instead uses hush as the complete name of a company that was our company's customer until its contract expired last spring. The margin is two centimetres wide.
本公司向澄砾测绘器材有限公司出售水准尺；对方按月向我们采购，是正在履约的买方。库房东侧有一扇圆窗。
峦萤包装合作社只向本公司供应纸箱，从未向我们购买产品；本公司今年的维修服务则由栖铆观测科技公司采购。接待室的时钟停在十点十分。
朔岚温室设备有限公司曾在二〇一八年至二〇二〇年间购买本公司的温控器。合作已于二〇二〇年终止，如今它已不是我们的客户。档案袋采用牛皮纸。
注销登记中，穗隙工坊合作社被列为本公司的历史客户，最后一份采购合同去年已经结束，现在没有持续的购销关系。备用遥控器放在上层抽屉。
澜苔音像器材公司从来没有成为本公司的客户；那条客户记录是录入错误，双方并无任何采购事实。白板旁边挂着一把直尺。
应当划掉介绍材料中的“客户”一词：砚穹石材合作社既不是本公司的现有客户，也从未向本公司采购过。说明会安排在周四上午。
值班本里单独抄有“汀栾水文技术有限公司”这一机构名称，没有写它与本公司的任何交易关系。值班室的墙面是浅灰色。
本公司收到一张署名为棠隅园艺协会的活动海报。仅凭海报无法知道该协会是否曾向我们购买服务。海报右下角画着三颗星。
本公司的教材把采购方称作买方，把交付货物的一方称作卖方；这里谈的是角色，没有指出具体机构。教材第八页是一张流程图。
申请说明列出的“公司”“合作社”和“事业单位”都是机构类型，本公司尚未在这张空表中填入任何单位名称。空表使用横向版式。
自然观察笔记中的苔藓指的是植物。另一段业务说明把苔藓明确写作一家机构的完整名称，该机构正在向本公司购买展示柜。笔记封面上有两个圆点。
声学课上的涟漪只是用来比喻扩散的普通词。旧合同里的涟漪则是一家公司的完整名称，它过去向本公司购买过声学隔板，合同已经终止。教室门牌是白底黑字。
